instruction: Pick up the hair gel bottle from the table and put it into the basket. Then take it back out of the basket and put it down on the table beside the basket. Standing or lying on the table are both fine.

steps.note: Pick up the hair gel bottle from the table and put it into the basket. Then take it back out of the basket and put it down on the table beside the basket. Standing or lying on the table are both fine.

Plan: 1. Localize the bottle and choose safe grasp and drop points. | 2. Approach from above and grasp the bottle. | 3. Lift the bottle, lower it into the basket, and release it. | 4. Reach into the basket and grasp the bottle again. | 5. Lift the bottle out, place it beside the basket, and release it. | 6. Withdraw the arm and verify the final arrangement.
steps.detail:
1. Localize the bottle and choose safe grasp and drop points. (done when: Bottle position and basket interior are clearly identified in the camera/depth view.)
2. Approach from above and grasp the bottle. (done when: The gripper is closed around the bottle and holding is true.)
3. Lift the bottle, lower it into the basket, and release it. (done when: The bottle is visible inside the basket and holding is false.)
4. Reach into the basket and grasp the bottle again. (done when: The bottle is reacquired inside the basket and holding is true.)
5. Lift the bottle out, place it beside the basket, and release it. (done when: The bottle is visible on clear table space beside the basket and holding is false.)
6. Withdraw the arm and verify the final arrangement. (done when: Camera pictures confirm the bottle is outside and beside the basket.)
